item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a straight copper wire in a closed loop with a cell and a switch. A compass sits beside the wire.

Imran closes the switch so that electric current flows through the wire.

Which prediction about the compass needle is correct?

options.A: The needle should deflect while current flows in the closed loop.
options.B: The needle should deflect even if the switch stays open, because the cell is present.
options.C: The needle should not deflect when current flows, because a copper wire is never magnetic.
options.D: Opening the switch makes the needle deflect more strongly than closing it.
